warnings: Grid bubbles ARE printed on this set (unlike the unlabelled สพฐ. sets 122/129/157): numbers 1-9 along x (8 bays x 4.50 = 36.00, every structural plan + A-03 + elevation 1), letters A, B, C along y (A-B 6.50, B-C 2.00, A-C 8.50). Origin A1 (top-left as drawn on S-01..S-04). Row A = classroom back wall (F2/C1), row B = corridor-side wall (F1/C1), row C = cantilevered corridor edge (no footing; steel corridor posts on the roof plan).

C' (10.10) is one line printed four ways: S-01 3.60 below B (row of the stair footings F3/C2), S-02 and A-03 1.60 below C (stair landing edge, beam B2), S-03/S-04 1.60 below C (roof eave), A-05 elevation 2 and A-07 section 1.60 beyond C (eave). 3.60 = 2.00 + 1.60 exactly, so all are the same point (rule 4: one point = one line).

A'' (2.167) and A''' (4.333): the two secondary-beam (B4) lines that split every A-B bay into three equal slab panels S2 on S-02. No dimension row prints them; the S2 slab detail on S-06 prints 'L=6.50/3', which fixes them at 6.50/3 and 2 x 6.50/3 (scale check on S-02: 2.17 / 4.32). Kept at 3 decimals; each carries its own lowered score.

2' (8.90): the A-03 floor plan and the A-09 stair plan/section print the bottom chain 4.60 | 1.75 | 1.00 | 1.75 | 1.00 (A-09 spells the flights '7 ลูกนอน @0.25=1.75'). 1.75 + 1.00 + 1.75 = 4.50 closes exactly on grid 5 and the last 1.00 on 5' (the 1.00 walkway on S-01), so the 4.60 ends on grid 4 and its first tick is 0.10 left of grid 3 (outer face of the landing wall). The same chain adds 4' (15.25) and 4'' (16.25), the landing edges. Measured on the scan the first tick is within a few cm of grid 3, so 2' keeps a lowered score.

Conflict: elevations 2 (A-05), 3 and 4 (A-06) label their levels '+0.90 ระดับพื้นภายใน' and '+4.40 ระดับคานหลังคา' while printing the same 3.10 / 3.50 chain from '±0.00 ระดับดินเดิม' as elevation 1 (+3.10 / +6.60), sections A-A (A-07) and B-B (A-08) (+3.10 / +6.60) and the floor-plan room tags (+3.10). Taken: +3.10 / +6.60 — four drawings plus the chain arithmetic (0.00 + 3.10 = 3.10) vs three drawings whose labels contradict their own chain (they look copied from another design). The stray labels are kept in unassigned_dimensions.

Ridge line (แนวสันหลังคา, S-03/S-04) sits about 4.25 from row A by scale (midway between the eaves A' and C') but no dimension is printed to it, so it gets no line (rule 4: no printed tick, no beam endpoint).

Element-internal dimensions stay on the elements (rule 4 exception): footing plan sizes / pile spacing chains (S-05, S-06), the 1.20 / 0.20 / 0.05 / 0.10 footing depth chains, beam and column section sizes, the B6 & B6' bar cut-off lengths 1.40, the stair geometry (S-07: 4.50 run, 2.80 rise, treads 0.25, risers 0.175, landing 1.00, waist t=0.12).

Dimension sweep covers the structural sheets S-01..S-08 and the architectural sheets A-03 (floor plan), A-04 (roof plan), A-05 / A-06 (elevations), A-07 / A-08 (sections A-A, B-B) and A-09 (stair). Not swept (op04 time budget, computer scheduled shutdown): A-10..A-15 architectural details, S-09..S-11 connection / roof-note sheets, E-01. Their dimension rows are not in dimension_chains[]; any line they alone would add is missing.
